description: Reserve an id and get a short-lived URL to PUT the file to, with the same Content-Type as mime_type and no other headers. The bytes go straight to storage, not through this API, and the file is recorded on its own once the PUT succeeds: pass the id to posts_save, media_save or anything else that takes a media id straight away. It shows in media_list within a few minutes.

mime_type.description: The exact Content-Type the PUT will send, e.g. video/mp4.

name: media_upload
title: Start a media upload
